This is the current list attempting to make it more clear what each one means

# Do not murder (there are more rules)
# Do not deprive people of lifesaving healthcare through instutional means
# Do not spread hatred or envy or deny others opportunities
# Contribute to and participate in your community
# Develop a clear mind
# Maintain a clear mind
# Honor your ancestors and environment
# Build up Qi in great amounts
# Have children



== Older Format ==
{{Alo inversion}}
This is the older list. As the alo inversion applies here. 

There are nine commandments, three from each covenant. They work as an increasing difficulty initiation

# [[Commandment Omega Omega]] do not kill ([[Receptive Omega]])
# [[Commandment Omega Lambda]] do not institutionally deprive of immortality
# [[Commandment Omega Alpha]] do not spread hatred ([[Active Omega]])
# [[Commandment Lambda Omega]] church duties
# [[Commandment Lambda Lambda]] achieve [[nobility]]
# [[Commandment Lambda Alpha]] maintain nobility
# [[Commandment Alpha Omega]] ancestor worship ([[Receptive Alpha]])
# [[Commandment Alpha Lambda]] [[apotheosis]]
# [[Commandment Alpha Alpha]] have children ([[Active Alpha]])

==Overview==
The Commandments system might be put in question since it is rarely interpreted correctly. But they are still somewhat there.


== Interpretations ==
The Nine Commandments are not a system like the [[ten commandments]] where everyone is under the obligation, they are merely a compilation of all the elements of the various [[covenants]]
